summary: Router 0.32.3 (diagnostics for #162): apply_ollama_state logs one journal line when a node's model list changes, naming the source (`agent report (rev N)` or `poll`), the count and the added/removed model names. No behaviour, route, configuration or payload change.

findings.evidence: The new line writes model names reported by a node (agent report or poll) and the agent's report revision into the router journal. Model names already appear in the journal (route lines) and in /admin/state; no prompt, user data, credential or address is logged. A node could choose long or odd model names; they are logged as reported, like in the existing route lines.
findings.resolution: Same data class as existing journal lines; logged only on a change, so a stable node adds no volume.

tests.evidence: all PASS (9 checks), including one journal line per change with source and revision, none for an unchanged list.
exit code 0, 332 PASS lines, no FAIL.

tests.command: ruff check .; python test/check_adr_index.py; python test/selftest_control_flow.py; python test/check_control_flow.py; python test/selftest_english_names.py
tests.evidence: All checks passed; ADR index ok: 97 ADRs; control flow ok: 0 legacy findings.

limitations: Diagnostics only; #162 itself stays open until the journal of the next router restart shows which report set the incomplete list.
